purpose: Repeatable project-agnostic creative comparison. No model is scored until its actual output has been reviewed.
scoring: Human review: unclear, partially achieved, achieved. Record model, contract version, prompt, references, output hashes, attempts and cost evidence. A continuity or dialogue failure cannot be averaged away.

cases.script:
INT. WORKSHOP - EVENING
Mira hides a broken wooden bird behind her back.
MIRA: I thought I could fix it.
Oren notices her shaking hand before looking at the bird.
OREN: Show me where it hurts.
Mira brings the bird forward.
review: Pause communicates vulnerability without exaggerated sadness
Bird stays in the same hand

cases.script:
EXT. COURTYARD - DAY
Pip balances a tall stack of empty cups.
PIP: Perfectly steady.
The top cup slips. Pip catches it with a foot.
Pip looks pleased. The bottom cup starts to tilt.
review: Readable setup, anticipation and delayed payoff
Audience can see the unstable cup
One clear action focus per beat
Cups and foot contact remain consistent

cases.script:
INT. GREENHOUSE - MORNING
Mira stands left of the doorway, facing Oren beside the red bench.
MIRA: Did you leave this for me?
She holds up the wooden bird.
OREN: I hoped you would find it.
Mira looks from the bird to Oren.
review: Establish scene axis and prop ownership
Motivated reverse angle has its own camera setup
Reverse opening retains eyelines without mirroring the world
Approved scene anchor distinguished from camera-match reference
